title: Reproducibility package for Computational Identification of Candidate Gene Families for Volatile Sulfur Compound Biosynthesis in Cannabis sativa Using Profile Hidden Markov Models
description: Query definitions, analysis code, search assignments, staged validation results, retained candidate sequences, expression cross-references, PF01053 phylogenetic artifacts, and manuscript presentation code supporting a survey of Cannabis sativa protein candidates. Source code is licensed under MIT; original data and documentation are licensed under CC BY 4.0.
references: Michael Lab Cannabis pangenome assemblies and data, https://resources.michael.salk.edu/resources/cannabis_genomes/index.html
Barbosa-Xavier et al. (2024), Cannabis Expression Atlas, https://doi.org/10.1111/ppl.70010
